descriptionByLocale.it: Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers. Part of the global Marketing team and reporting directly to the Brand Director, this role plays a central role in safeguarding, shaping and activating the Explora Journeys brand across all touchpoints, with a particular focus on brand campaigns, the fleet and new brand developments. Based at our headquarters in Geneva, this role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, product storytelling, and execution, working closely with Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media, and Digital teams to bring the brand to life with clarity, consistency and emotional depth, across markets. Your Impact Brand Management & Governance - Act as a core guardian of the Explora Journeys brand, supporting the Brand Director in the day to day management, development, and evolution of the brand. - Ensure consistent application of brand identity, tone of voice, messaging, and visual language across all touchpoints, channels, and guest journeys. - Lead the development, evolution and maintenance of brand guidelines, frameworks, and master toolkits, ensuring relevance, clarity, and scalability globally. - Monitor brand execution across markets and partners, proactively identifying inconsistencies and working collaboratively with stakeholders to safeguard luxury and hospitality standards. - Contribute to brand strategy initiatives, brand evolution projects, and internal brand education, strengthening brand understanding and alignment across the organisation. Campaigns, Content & Brand Activation - Lead the development and delivery of master brand and product campaigns, in line with brand strategy and commercial priorities. - Oversee the creation of hero brand and product assets, including key visuals, copy frameworks, brochures, photography, and videography. - Work closely with Media, Digital, and PR teams to ensure a coherent and premium brand expression across paid, owned, and earned channels. - Manage and curate brand, product and fleet content within DAM and PIM systems, ensuring accuracy, ease of use and global market adoption. Product Marketing – Fleet & Onboard Experience - Own and articulate the brand and product narrative for the Explora Journeys fleet, translating ship design, onboard experiences and service philosophy into compelling, clear, and guest-centric storytelling. - Act as a key brand partner to Product, New Builds and Hotel Operations teams, supporting projects throughout the ship lifecycle; from early concept through delivery, launch and in-service evolution. - Define and activate ship level propositions and concepts, onboard experiences, suite concepts, culinary, wellness and retail pillars, and service rituals. - Ensure alignment between the onboard guest experience and the brand promise communicated to market. Launch & Go to Market Coordination - Support brand and product readiness for new brand initiatives, campaigns, ship launches, major milestones, and onboard innovations. - Develop master launch toolkits to equip channels, markets, Sales, and PR with clear narratives, positioning and assets. - Ensure consistency, clarity and brand alignment across all internal and external communications related to brand, fleet and product evolution. Cross Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence - Act as a trusted brand partner across functions, fostering alignment between brand, product, commercial, and operational teams - Coordinate budgets, suppliers, forecasting, purchase orders, and invoicing related to brand initiatives. - Balance strategic brand thinking with hands on execution in a fast paced environment. Your Journey so far - Master’s degree in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, or a related field. - 8+ years’ experience in brand management and campaign building. - Prior experience within luxury, premium or high-end travel, hospitality or consumer brands strongly preferred. - Proven experience operating in a global headquarters environment, managing brand frameworks and master assets across markets. - Experience managing agencies and external creative partners. Your Essentials - Exposure to product marketing and physical experience‑based products (ships, hotels, resorts, or complex premium environments highly desirable). - Strong creative sensibility combined with operational rigour, attention to detail and stakeholder management skills. - Comfortable moving between strategic brand thinking and detailed execution. - Fluent in English; additional European languages are a strong advantage. At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony. We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea. Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

Your Purpose We are seeking a high-caliber, dedicated PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager to oversee a strategic infrastructure investment project in the Caribbean, while establishing governance and execution discipline across current and future projects in the investment pipeline. This role carries full accountability for project delivery, spanning finance, construction, commercial, operational, HR, regulatory, and stakeholder dimensions. The successful candidate will act as the single point of coordination and control between investors, contractors, operators, lenders, and government stakeholders. Your Impact
• Establish and lead a Project Management System, including governance, reporting, controls, and KPIs.
• Drive end-to-end execution of major infrastructure projects, from development through construction and into operations.
• Oversees construction delivery and project financials, including budgets, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, lender requirements, and reporting.
• Lead commercial and contract management, supplier, and concession PPP agreements.
• Ensure operational readiness and handover, including systems, staffing, and procedures.
• Coordinate HR and workforce planning, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and effective contractor management.
• Identify and manage project risks across technical, financial, regulatory, ESG, and political dimensions.
• Provide PMO oversight and execution support for additional projects in the development funnel. Your Journey so far
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
• 15+ years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or real asset projects.
• Demonstrated leadership of complex, capital-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders.
• Strong experience across construction, project finance, commercial contracts, and operations.
• Experience in emerging markets and/or the Caribbean region strongly preferred.
• PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent certification preferred. Your Essentials
• Hands-on, structured, and highly accountable
• Executive presence and credibility with senior stakeholders
• Comfortable working in complex, multi-jurisdictional environments
• Willing to travel and be on-site as required Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only. Leadership Development - Design and implement leadership development programs supporting both shipboard and shore-based leadership populations. - Establish a global leadership framework aligned with the company’s values and guest-centric culture. - Strengthen leadership capabilities in areas such as: - people leadership - operational decision-making - service excellence - innovation and continuous improvement - cross-cultural leadership Your Journey so far Education - Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field. descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose The Culinary Operations Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight for all culinary operations across the fleet. The Manager of Culinary Operations is a strategic role on the overall financial cost of the culinary department, monitoring and guiding the team, and actively participating in recruitment for leadership positions within the culinary function. Acting as the strategic link between the corporate office in Geneva and the traveling and shipboard teams, this role ensures consistent quality, compliance with corporate standards, and continuous culinary innovation. This role directly reports to the Vice President of F&B. Your Impact Strategic Culinary Leadership - Provide visionary leadership and guidance for the culinary team across the fleet, ensuring alignment with brand philosophy. - Define, implement, and uphold fleet-wide culinary operational standards and best practices. - Play an active role in strategic planning for all F&B service and beverage needs. - Lead menu development, recipe creation, and implementation of culinary projects. Operational Oversight & Quality Assurance - Conduct structured operational reviews, remote audits, and ship visits as required. - Ensure food quality, presentation, and consistency across all vessels. - Monitor guest satisfaction metrics and implement strategic improvements. - Ensure compliance with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols. - Oversee beverage order and loading coordination. Training & Leadership Development - Mentor and develop future culinary leaders and onboard chefs. - Design and implement fleet-wide training programs in line with brand standards. - Foster long-term succession planning for culinary leadership positions. Human Resources & Team Management - Drive a high-performance culture emphasizing recognition, development, and fairness. - Oversee leadership performance reviews, promotions, and career pathing. - Support HR in recruitment for senior culinary positions and host rotations. Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination - Act as the principal liaison for all culinary matters between corporate headquarters and the fleet. - Coordinate galley equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards. - Compile operational and financial reports for corporate leadership. Financial Oversight - Overseeing food orders and maintaining the food master list to ensure accuracy, proper order planning, and sequence management. - Responsible for overall financial cost of the culinary department. - Implement continuous improvement plans to meet or exceed economic targets. - Oversee cost control, inventory optimization, and resource planning. - Play a key role for the overall financial cost of the culinary department. Your Journey so far - Minimum 15 years in high-end culinary operations with advanced skills. - At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations. - Proven experience in fleet-wide or multi-site culinary management. Your Essentials Leadership & Communication - Dynamic, strategic leader with experience managing multicultural teams. - Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset. Technical & Operational Knowledge - Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and industry-specific systems. - Knowledge of HR protocols, time and attendance compliance, and labor regulations. - Expertise in culinary operations, menu development, and luxury hospitality standards. This role is designed for a data-driven professional with a strong commercial acumen, an analytical mindset, and a passion for optimizing mobile user journeys. The successful candidate will explore in-app behaviors, remove friction in the sales funnel, and drive product-led initiatives to maximize conversion rates and shape the future of digital guest experiences across the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

Your Impact

- Analyze the MSC for Me in-app user journey and behavior to identify bottlenecks, proposing and validating product initiatives that optimize the sales funnel and boost in-app conversion rates.

- Collaborate with Product, Tech, and UX/UI cross-functional teams to design and implement features that drive organic user acquisition and increase cross-selling/up-selling opportunities for the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Implement and optimize the in-app position of commercial offerings (working closing with Onboard Revenues Commercial Department) to maximize visibility and sales conversions specifically for mobile users.

- Use advanced product analytics tools and data visualization (Power BI) to track sales performance, user activation rates, and drop-offs into the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Act as a bridge between the Onboard Revenues Commercial department and the Tech/Development teams, translating revenue goals into clear digital product requirements to enhance the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Drive MSC for Me  channel-led acquisition by refining native in-app features—such as frictionless guest-to-registered user flows, invite-a-friend mechanisms, and seamless app sharing—to grow the user base.

- Conduct A/B testing on MSC for Me  in-app sales flows, checkout processes, and subscription models to continuously improve operational efficiency and revenue generation.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing Management, Digital or a related field.

- Strong commercial and analytical skills with 3 to 5 years of proven experience in digital sales, product growth, or digital business development, with a strict focus on mobile applications.

- Hands-on experience with app analytics, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and data manipulation/visualization tools (Power BI, SQL; Python is a plus).

- Familiarity with agile methodologies and ability to work side-by-side with developers and product managers in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate data-driven insights into actionable business and product recommendations.

- Creative thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving, capable of driving "Product-Led Growth" rather than relying on traditional marketing spend.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

- Deep understanding of mobile user behavior, digital sales funnels, and product-centric acquisition ecosystems.

Your Purpose

The Senior Digital Acquisition Manager will be responsible for leading the digital marketing strategy across all MSC Cruises markets, with a focus on driving direct sales through digital advertising levers, setting and achieving KPIs, and developing innovative digital campaigns across multiple channels. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in performance marketing and digital sales development at a positive ROAS, along with strong expertise in digital advertising campaign strategy, paid media planning and implementation, and team leadership. Additionally, the role will involve developing affiliation and partnership programs as part of an integrated digital engagement strategy to broaden reach, drive qualified traffic, and support long-term customer value.

Your Impact

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with MSC stakeholders across various markets, with a deep understanding of their business needs, challenges, and opportunities—while balancing the global objectives set by headquarters.

• Set and achieve KPIs for online sales through digital advertising levers, ensuring the media agency delivers against targets and contractual obligations.

• Lead internal meetings, QBRs, and annual reviews by providing strategic insights and recommendations based on campaign performance, website analytics, market trends, and the competitive landscape.

• Plan and implement innovative performance marketing campaigns across Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio, and Video channels—tailored to business goals and market dynamics.

• Collaborate with internal teams—including Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product, and agency partners—to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality assets aligned with annual digital sales targets.

• Identify and pursue opportunities to enhance revenue streams through existing and new digital strategies, while improving campaign ROAS and experimenting with innovations in the adtech and martech ecosystem.

• Develop and manage lead generation strategies, ensuring effective customer acquisition flows and nurturing tactics are in place across all paid media touchpoints.

• Maintain oversight of account resourcing and profitability to ensure HQ and local markets are managed efficiently and profitably.

• Serve as the main escalation point for concerns raised by internal teams or local market stakeholders.

• Continuously review and optimize operational workflows, proposing and implementing process improvements where relevant.

• Collaborate with country and HQ stakeholders to prepare and manage the annual digital marketing budget, aligned with MSC Cruises’ B2C revenue goals.

• Lead and optimize affiliate and partnership programs to drive qualified traffic and conversions, ensuring alignment with digital acquisition strategy and performance goals.

• Manage key partners and co-branded initiatives, coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and tracking.

Your Journey so far

• 7+ years of experience in a similar role.
• Hands-on experience with analytics and ad server tools such as GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager and their relevant reporting frameworks.
• Proven experience in managing, mentoring, and upskilling team members.
• Past experience in lead generation strategy and execution is a strong plus.
• Solid experience in budget ownership and cost control.

Your Essentials

• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to leverage data for informed decision-making.
• Proven track record of driving direct sales growth and improving ROAS through high-performing digital advertising campaigns.
• Passion for digital marketing, performance media, and innovative digital solutions.
• Deep knowledge of Google and Meta ad platforms, including setup auditing, implementation, and performance analysis with actionable insights.
• Excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office and data visualization tools such as Datorama.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and external partners.
• Ability to identify trends in data and transform insights into actionable strategic recommendations.
• Self-starter with the ability to work independently and take initiative.
• Confident, articulate presenter—comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and internal teams.
• Strong strategic thinking, capable of acting as a ‘Trusted Advisor’ to senior leadership.
• High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Positive attitude, proactive mindset, and a drive to embrace new challenges.
• Knowledge of affiliate platforms such as Awin, Kwanko, and similar tools. Strong network of industry contacts to initiate partnership opportunities and brand collaborations.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. As a Casino Slot and Technical Operations Manager, you will be responsible for monitoring slot machine performance, analysing gaming data, and implementing strategies to enhance player satisfaction and profitability. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.
• Manage budgets, control costs, and optimise resource allocation.
• Support and guide onboard Casino management team on each vessel through constant communication and regular ship operational visits. Discuss any areas of concern specific to the Operation and brand specific product, and similarly address points of commendation.
• Provide accurate and objective assessment of onboard Casino operations and personnel.
• Revenue analysis, identifying trends with the ability to create structured solutions to increase or enhance revenue streams. Explore new ways of increasing existing revenue and /or improving current working practices, whilst at the same time maintaining a high technical and security standard onboard our ships.
• Isolate areas falling below standard with members of the Casino Shipboard management team.
• Training of all management teams in Slot Revenue, Security and Surveillance.
• Confirm that security measures meet minimum requirements.
• Provide troubleshooting support and advice via email to shipboard technical teams.
• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

Your Essentials

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.

Il tuo scopo

Unisciti a MSC Crociere per un entusiasmante stage focalizzato su analisi, monitoraggio delle prestazioni e generazione di informazioni in due aree strategiche: Customer Journey e il nostro miglior programma.

Questo ruolo è ideale per qualcuno appassionato di analisi dei dati, generazione di insight e creazione di dashboard, con un forte interesse a migliorare l'esperienza dei dipendenti e degli ospiti attraverso un impatto misurabile.

Sosterrai lo sviluppo di analisi strutturate e meccanismi di follow-up, lavorando a stretto contatto con il reparto Customer Journey e HR. Il ruolo fornisce un'esposizione pratica sia agli analytics orientati agli ospiti che ai dipendenti.

Il tuo impatto

Viaggio dei clienti:

- Sostenere le analisi del Customer Journey ricorrenti, incluse le recensioni basate su tela, le analisi della nave di mezza stagione e i responsabili dei comitati.

- Contribuire a analisi approfondite ad hoc su argomenti specifici, segmenti ospiti, nazionalità o navi, in base alle richieste di business e gestione.

- Assicurare l'accuratezza dei dati, la consistenza e l'allineamento attraverso il Customer Journey consegnabili e reporting.

Il nostro programma BEST:

- Sostenere lo sviluppo, la manutenzione e il monitoraggio dei framework KPI per il nostro programma BEST.

- Consolidare e analizzare i dati provenienti da più fonti, inclusi i sondaggi di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti, il feedback dei nostri clienti, la formazione di NPS e i relativi indicatori degli ospiti.

- Costruire, aggiornare e mantenere le dashboard per monitorare le prestazioni del programma, l'impegno e l'impatto nel tempo.

- Assicurare la coerenza dei dati, la precisione e gli standard di report in tutti i nostri output di analisi BEST.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Laurea (o attualmente iscritta) in Business, Data Analytics, Ospitalità o un campo relativo

- Forte mentalità analitica con attenzione ai dettagli

- Avanzate competenze di Excel; la conoscenza degli strumenti di dashboard (ad esempio Power BI, Tableau) è un plus

- Forte capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di tradurre i dati in insight strutturati

- Fluente in inglese

I tuoi essenziali

Competenze consigliate

- No.
Conoscenza di base delle metriche di soddisfazione degli ospiti e NPS

- No.
Comprensione di base delle metriche di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti

- Esperienza con strumenti di visualizzazione e reporting dati

- Interessi nel viaggio dei clienti, nell'esperienza degli ospiti e nel miglioramento dei servizi

- Familiarità con l'analisi dei dati dell'indagine e l'analisi a risposta aperta

Cosa ti offre questo ruolo:

- Esperienza pratica nell'analisi, sviluppo KPI e dashboard

- Esposizione all'impatto reale del business attraverso il processo decisionale basato sui dati

- Opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente globale e dinamico

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

titleByLocale.it: Direttore delle Operazioni - Infrastrutture di accoglienza

descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Direttore delle Operazioni è responsabile per la progettazione, la mobilitazione, l'apertura e il funzionamento in corso di grandi dimensioni navi da crociera e infrastrutture di ospitalità. Il ruolo assicura la continuità dello sviluppo attraverso operazioni a stato costante, agendo come proprietario operativo dalle prime fasi di costruzione attraverso prestazioni a lungo termine. Lavorando in parallelo con lo sviluppo, la costruzione e l'esperienza degli ospiti, il direttore delle operazioni garantisce che i beni sono operabili dal design, completamente pronti all'apertura e in modo sostenibile, sicuro e redditizio in seguito. Il vostro impatto 1. Leadership operativa Attraverso il ciclo di vita delle risorse proprie responsabilità operativa end-to-end dalla pre-apertura attraverso operazioni dal vivo. Definire la visione operativa a lungo termine, KPI e standard di servizio. Garantire continuità di progettazione, cultura e sistemi dalla fase di progetto alle operazioni a stato costante. 2. Pre-apertura e mobilitazione (Parallel to Construction) Guidare il programma di disponibilità operativa allineato con pietre miliari di costruzione. In coordinamento con Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment ecc.), definisce le esigenze di Procurements e implementarlo. FFE/OWS. Decisioni di progettazione di influenza per garantire efficienza operativa, sicurezza e manutenbilità. Stabilire strutture operative, SOP e governance ben prima dell'apertura. Gestire gli abbonamenti dalla costruzione alle operazioni, compresi i fatturato phased. Per ogni progetto, identificare le necessità del personale e - in combinazione con le risorse umane- garantire la capacità operativa di nuovi asset. Stabilire programmi di formazione per la disponibilità operativa. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Operazioni giornaliere dirette in tutti i dipartimenti (ospitalità, F&B, vendita al dettaglio, attrazioni, marine, sicurezza, manutenzione, servizi ospiti). Assicurare la consegna di esperienze, sicurezza, qualità dei servizi e standard di marca. Guidare la stabilità operativa durante le fasi di rampa e maturità. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso il bene. 4. Forza di lavoro, formazione e cultura costruire, condurre e mantenere una forza lavoro multinazionale ad alto rendimento. Mantenere ed evolvere i programmi di formazione post-apertura. Integra una cultura orientata alla sicurezza e alle prestazioni. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operativo P&L, controlli dei costi e metriche di produttività. Gestisci bilanci operativi, capex pianificazione e riserve del ciclo di vita. Collaborare con i team commerciali per ottimizzare i ricavi (F&B, retail, esperienze, escursioni a riva dove applicabile). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Assicurare il rispetto costante di tutti gli standard normativi, marittimi, sanitari, di sicurezza e ambientali. Guidare la preparazione di emergenza, la gestione delle crisi e la pianificazione della continuità aziendale. Servire come responsabile per gli audit e le ispezioni. Il vostro viaggio finora - 15+ anni senior operazioni leadership in ospitalità, destinazioni da crociera, resort, porti, parchi a tema o grandi attività di ospitalità. - Proprietà dimostrata delle operazioni pre-apertura e a lungo termine. - Forte background che lavora insieme a team di sviluppo, costruzione e servizi tecnici. - Esperienza in ambienti caraibici o isolati fortemente preferito. Il vostro Essentials - Operazioni di prontezza e di ciclo di vita - Leader della forza lavoro su larga scala - Contabilità finanziaria e P&L - Gestione del ciclo di vita e della manutenzione - Gestione multioperatoria e delle concessioni Il nostro impegno Siamo impegnati a costruire un futuro che valorizza prospettive diverse, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valutato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il loro sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Director of Operations is accountable for the design, mobilization, opening and ongoing operation of large-scale cruise and hospitality infrastructure assets. The role ensures continuity from development through steady-state operations, acting as the operational owner from early construction phases through long-term performance. Working in parallel with Development, Construction and Guest Experience, the Director of Operations guarantees that assets are operable by design, fully ready at opening, and sustainably efficient, safe and profitable thereafter. Your Impact 1. Operational Leadership Across the Asset Lifecycle Own end-to-end operational responsibility from pre-opening through live operations. Define the long-term operating vision, KPIs and service standards. Ensure continuity of design, culture and systems from project phase into steady-state operations. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Lead the operational readiness program aligned with construction milestones. In coordination with Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.), define Procurements needs and implement it. FFE/OWS. Influence design decisions to ensure operational efficiency, safety and maintainability. Establish operating structures, SOPs and governance well ahead of opening. Manage handovers from construction to operations, including phased turnovers. For each project, identify personnel need and -in conjunction with HR- ensure the operational ability of new assets. Establish Training Programs for operational readiness. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Direct daily operations across all departments (hospitality, F&B, retail, attractions, marine, security, maintenance, guest services). Ensure delivery of guest experience, safety, service quality and brand standards. Drive operational stability during ramp-up and maturity phases. Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the asset. 4. Workforce, Training & Culture Build, lead and retain a high-performing, multi-national workforce. Maintain and evolve training programs post-opening. Embed a safety-first, service-oriented and performance-driven culture. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operational P&L, cost controls and productivity metrics. Manage operating budgets, capex planning and lifecycle reserves. Collaborate with commercial teams to optimize revenue (F&B, retail, experiences, shore excursions where applicable). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Ensure ongoing compliance with all regulatory, maritime, health, safety and environmental standards. Lead emergency preparedness, crisis management and business continuity planning. Serve as the accountable executive for audits and inspections. Your Journey so far - 15+ years senior operations leadership in hospitality, cruise destinations, resorts, ports, theme parks or large hospitality assets. - Demonstrated ownership of both pre-opening and long-term operations. - Strong background working alongside development, construction and technical services teams. - Experience in Caribbean or island environments strongly preferred. descriptionByLocale.de: Ihr Ziel Der Operationsdirektor ist verantwortlich für das Design, die Mobilisierung, die Eröffnung und den laufenden Betrieb von großen Kreuzfahrt- und Gastfreundschaft-Infrastrukturanlagen. Die Rolle sorgt für Kontinuität von der Entwicklung durch stationäre Operationen, die als Betriebsinhaber von frühen Bauphasen durch langfristige Leistung fungieren. Parallel zur Entwicklungs-, Bau- und Gasterfahrung garantiert der Leiter der Geschäftstätigkeit, dass die Vermögenswerte durch Design, vollständig bereit zur Eröffnung und nachhaltig effizient, sicher und profitabel sind. Ihre Auswirkungen 1. Operationelle Führung über den Asset Lifecycle Eigene operative End-to-End-Verantwortung von der Voröffnung durch Live-Operationen. Definieren Sie die Langzeit-Betriebsvision, Kennzahlen und Servicestandards. Gewährleistung der Kontinuität von Design, Kultur und Systemen von der Projektphase bis hin zu stationären Betrieben. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Führen Sie das betriebsbereite Programm im Einklang mit Bau Meilensteinen. In Abstimmung mit Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.) definieren Sie die Beschaffungsbedürfnisse und implementieren sie. FFE/OWS. Einflussentscheidungen zur Sicherstellung der betrieblichen Effizienz, Sicherheit und Aufrechterhaltungsfähigkeit. Stellen Sie operative Strukturen, SOPs und Governance vor der Eröffnung fest. Ausbildungsprogramme für Betriebsbereitschaft einrichten. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Direkte tägliche Operationen in allen Abteilungen (Krankheit, F&B, Einzelhandel, Attraktionen, Marine, Sicherheit, Wartung, Gastdienste). Führen Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen in der gesamten Anlage. 4. Workforce, Training & Culture Aufbauen, führen und behalten eine hochperformierende, multinationale Arbeitskräfte. Zusammenarbeit mit kommerziellen Teams zur Optimierung des Umsatzes (F&B, Einzelhandel, Erfahrungen, Küstenausflüge, gegebenenfalls). 6. descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Le Directeur des opérations est responsable de la conception, de la mobilisation, de l'ouverture et de l'exploitation continue de grands équipements de croisière et d'accueil. Ce rôle assure la continuité du développement par des opérations en état d'équilibre, agissant en tant que propriétaire opérationnel depuis les premières phases de construction jusqu'à la performance à long terme. Parallèlement au développement, à la construction et à l'expérience des invités, le Directeur des opérations garantit que les actifs sont exploitables par la conception, prêts à l'ouverture et durables, sûrs et rentables par la suite. 1. Leadership opérationnel Tout au long du cycle de vie de l'actif Responsabilité opérationnelle de bout en bout de la préouverture à des opérations réelles. Définir la vision opérationnelle à long terme, les ICR et les normes de service. Assurer la continuité de la conception, de la culture et des systèmes depuis la phase du projet jusqu'aux opérations en état d'équilibre. 2. Préouverture et mobilisation (parallèle à la construction) Diriger le programme de préparation opérationnelle aligné sur les étapes de construction. En coordination avec les Services invités (F&B, HK, Entertainment, etc.), définir les besoins en matière d'approvisionnement et les mettre en oeuvre. - Oui. Influencer les décisions de conception pour assurer l'efficacité opérationnelle, la sécurité et la maintenance. Établir les structures opérationnelles, les PON et la gouvernance bien avant l'ouverture. Gérer les transferts de la construction à l'exploitation, y compris les roulements échelonnés. Pour chaque projet, déterminer les besoins en personnel et, de concert avec les RH, assurer la capacité opérationnelle des nouveaux biens. Établir des programmes de formation pour la préparation opérationnelle. 3. Gestion des opérations après l'ouverture Diriger les opérations quotidiennes dans tous les ministères (hôpital, F&B, détail, attractions, maritime, sécurité, entretien, services aux clients). Assurer la livraison de l'expérience client, la sécurité, la qualité du service et les normes de marque. Conduire la stabilité opérationnelle pendant les phases de montée en puissance et de maturité. Diriger des initiatives d'amélioration continue dans l'ensemble de l'actif. 4. Main-d'œuvre, formation et culture Construisez, dirigez et maintenez une main-d'oeuvre multinationale hautement performante. Maintenir et développer les programmes de formation après l'ouverture. Intégrer une culture axée sur la sécurité, le service et la performance. 5. Rendement financier et commercial Propre P&L opérationnelle, contrôle des coûts et indicateurs de productivité. Gérer les budgets d'exploitation, la planification du capex et les réserves du cycle de vie. Collaborer avec des équipes commerciales pour optimiser les revenus (F&B, détail, expériences, excursions à terre, le cas échéant). 6. Conformité, sécurité et gestion des risques Assurer la conformité continue à toutes les normes réglementaires, maritimes, sanitaires, de sécurité et environnementales. • Drive structured adoption of personalization and audience activation tools. 3. Platform Business Ownership

• Define functional requirements, prioritization and business roadmap.
• Partner with IT, as technical owner, for architecture, integrations, security and scalability.
• Ensure operational excellence of automations, data flows and activation processes. 4. Data Governance & Compliance
• Define lifecycle communication standards in alignment with Legal and IT.
• Ensure consent management and subscription governance frameworks are operationalized within marketing automation tools.
• Support privacy-by-design principles across activation use cases. 5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Define CRM contribution metrics and dashboards.
• Monitor engagement, retention and revenue influence.
• Provide optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. 6. Lead the development of a customer insights framework, leveraging CRM data, external ad hoc research to inform brand health evolution. Translate customer understanding into actionable growth opportunities. Partner with Guest Experience teams, Marketing and Commercial teams to design and prioritize customer research initiatives, including satisfaction tracking, journey analysis, loyalty drivers, brand tracking,etc. 7. Team & Capability Building

• Elevate internal understanding of marketing automation capabilities and limitations.
• Drive adoption and maturity of audience strategy and segmentation practices. Your Journey so far

• Deep understanding of CRM platforms, marketing automation tools and data-driven marketing,
• Solid knowledge on global standards for data capture, consent management, governance, and enrichment
• Strong analytical mindset with experience translating CRM data into actionable insights. Experience leading customer insights initiatives such as segmentation studies, loyalty drivers, NPS/satisfaction research or journey diagnostics.
• Proven people manager, able to build, structure and develop teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Strong track record of working hands-on while leading strategically, especially in complex or fast-growth environments.
• Experience managing agencies and external partners.
• Prior experience in luxury, premium or high-end consumer brands strongly preferred as well as Travel & hospitality Your Essentials
• Strategic, customer-centric and commercially minded leader.
